description: This file defines an interface and methods for managing Kubernetes events, including creating, updating, patching, and searching events within specific namespaces, with deprecated methods and context-aware variants.

classes.name: EventSinkImpl
classes.description: A temporary wrapper that implements event creation, update, and patching using the EventInterface.

methods.name: CreateWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new event, returning the server's copy or an error.

methods.name: UpdateWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Updates an existing event, returning the server's copy or an error.

methods.name: PatchWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Patches an existing event, returning the server's copy or an error.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Finds events about a specified object, deprecated in favor of SearchWithContext.

methods.name: SearchWithContext
methods.description: Finds events about a specified object with context.

methods.name: GetFieldSelector
methods.description: Returns a field selector for filtering events based on involved object details.
